description: Use this when the person asks about faxes they've sent from their Faxette account, like what they sent last week or which faxes failed. Returns 25 at a time, newest first. Pass next_page back as page for the next 25. Filter with status, for example ["failed"] or ["delivered"]. Use get_fax for one fax's details. Needs the person to sign in to Faxette; calling it while they aren't asks the app to sign them in. It changes nothing.

organization.description: An organization's id from get_organizations, to list the faxes its members sent. Leave it out for the person's own.

page.description: The next_page from the previous call.

name: get_faxes

id.description: Pass it to get_fax for the details.

url.description: The fax's page, where the person checks it and pays. Give it to them.

next_page.description: Pass it as page for the next 25. Null on the last page.

title: List faxes
